title: Launching Sora responsibly
description: To address the novel safety challenges posed by a state-of-the-art video model as well as a new social creation platform, we’ve built Sora 2 and the Sora app with safety at the foundation. Our approach is anchored in concrete protections.

title: Sora 2 System Card
description: Sora 2 is our new state of the art video and audio generation model. Building on the foundation of Sora, this new model introduces capabilities that have been difficult for prior video models to achieve– such as more accurate physics, sharper realism, synchronized audio, enhanced steerability, and an expanded stylistic range.

title: Sora 2 is here
description: This post introduced Sora 2, a video generation model with synchronized dialogue and sound effects. The Sora product is no longer available.

title: Into the Omniverse: Open-Source Physics Engine and OpenUSD Advance Robot Learning
description: Building robots that can effectively operate alongside human workers in factories, hospitals and public spaces presents an enormous technical challenge. These robots require humanlike dexterity, perception, cognition and whole-body coordination to navigate unpredictable real-world environments in real time.
